set.body: Native owner for ScalaFIM eco-u6-surface-mvpa. Move locus-only surface patch measurement composition into SpatialMeasurementFrames; optional surface module owns TriangleMesh support graphs over neurosurf4s; optional atlas module composes public neuroatlas4s realizations into MVPA measurements/scatter. Preserve runtime owner, parcel/vertex IDs, order, masking, literal fingerprints and scientific results. Core/locus remain independent of imaging/atlas providers; no reverse dependency. Run owning JVM/JS suites and independent public consumers; source/closure review and publication on scoped branch. Keep fMRI FamilyThreshold policy in ScalaFIM.
set.title: Add optional surface and atlas MVPA measurement integrations
